cases.question: What water damage does the policy exclude?

chunks.text: This synthetic homeowners policy excludes flood damage and surface water entering the insured property.
The policy covers direct physical loss caused by accidental fire, subject to all limits and exclusions.
The policyholder must give prompt notice of a loss and provide the date and location of the event.
For a covered windstorm loss, the policyholder pays the stated wind deductible before benefits are payable.
Reasonable temporary repairs may be covered when needed to protect insured property from further damage.
